clips.label: Current repaint · 0.6
clips.note: More rewriting of roofs and small buildings
clips.details:
The same canyon-city source and unchanged prompt for four seconds. No spatial motion, prompt transition, reference image or pixel blending. Every update consumes its own previous result. Compare roof outlines, windows, metallic highlights and arch shading.

Krea 2 Turbo FP8, CFG 1, Euler (three model evaluations), three sampling intervals, starting noise 0.6. Fresh independent Gaussian noise at every repaint, with the same seed sequence across branches. Sampling starts from the VAE-encoded previous painting.

Four updates per second (cadence 6), 24 fps throughout. Shared opening plus fifteen updates. Identical RIFE 4.25 scale 1 only for finishing; the last quarter-second holds the final painting. This stationary diagnostic does not establish behavior during motion or scene changes.

clips.label: Direct latent feedback · 0.1
clips.note: Encode once; preserve latent between repaints
clips.details:
Same stationary city, unchanged prompt, seeds, CFG1 and three Euler intervals from starting noise0.1. The first painting exactly matches the ordinary0.1 branch.

The source is encoded once. Each generated latent goes directly into the next sampler; decoded images are saved for viewing but never re-encoded as feedback. Compare against Much lighter repaint0.1 to isolate repeated image reconstruction. This diagnostic has no spatial movement and does not implement latent-space warping.

Fifteen recurrent repaints plus the opening, four paintings per second, four seconds,24fps and identical RIFE4.25 scale1 finishing. All anchors preserved; final quarter-second holds. Interpolation never feeds back into generation.
